messages:
Priya Kaur: Quick heads-up — launching a micro-seg nudge experiment for the webinar follow-up this Thu 9am PT. Goal: +15% webinar→demo conversion vs baseline. Plan:
- Segments: (1) High-engaged (attended + asked Qs), (2) Registrants-no-show, (3) Clickers (clicked but didn't register)
- Cadences: A = 3 short nudges over 5 days; B = single long-form nudge with benchmark stat
Draft subject lines and bodies below. Need sign-off on subject lines + seed lists by EOD tomorrow.

Emily Chen: Sounds good. What's our target sample size per arm? Also which metric is the primary conversion (demo booking vs product trial)? :thinking_face:

Priya Kaur: Targeting ~2k users per segment per arm (so ~12k sends total). Primary conversion = demo booking (we'll track trial signups as a secondary metric).
Seg logic (pseudo):
```sql
-- registrants-no-show
SELECT user_id FROM webinar_registrations r
LEFT JOIN webinar_attendance a USING(user_id)
WHERE r.event_id = 2026_03_20 AND a.user_id IS NULL;
```
(we'll hand to eng to run and produce lists)

Marco Alvarez: Can we reuse the benchmark narrative we used in the last benchmark email? That stat bumped CTR before. If legal is ok, I prefer the short punchy stat in the subject. :+1:

Priya Kaur: Yes — plan is: condensed blurb in body + 1 stat in subject line. Candidate subjects (pick 1 each variant):
- "How teams cut inference cost ~40% — webinar replay"
- "New benchmark: same quality, lower serving cost"
- "Watch: 40% less cost for production LLMs"
(Emily / Legal: need a quick sign-off on the exact percent wording)

Jordan Lee: I'll queue this in SendGrid. Template = `wkly_webinar_nudge_v4`. Seed list path = `lists/marketing/webinar-seed.csv`. Tracking: utm_campaign=microseg_nudge_176842.
Which subject variants do we want in the A/B? A = short stat, B = long-form replay CTA?

Priya Kaur: Exactly — A = stat + replay CTA, B = long-form value prop + demo CTA. Also: small personalization tokens for top-engaged segment: `{{first_name}}`, `{{company}}`. Here's the short body draft: 
"Hey {{first_name}},
Missed the live session? Watch the 20-min replay to see how teams are lowering inference cost without trading quality. See one example where a customer cut per-token spend by ~40%."

Emily Chen: I'll ping legal on the 40% phrasing now. Also confirm we have Spanish templates for EMEA sends?

Marco Alvarez: I can prep the condensed benchmark blurb and Spanish copy. Will post copy by EOD tomorrow.

Priya Kaur: Great — next steps:
1) @Emily legal check on the 40% claim (by EOD)
2) @Marco finalize copy + Spanish version (by EOD)
3) @Jordan queue variants in SendGrid and add tracking (tomorrow morning)
4) QA send to seed list once templates are wired (Wed AM)
Schedule: Thu 9am PT primary send, stagger EMEA at 4pm local.

marketing-bot: Campaign scheduled: `microseg_nudge_176842` — Preview URLs posted to the campaign workspace.

Jordan Lee: On it. I added the preview links and test seed send for Wed 09:00 PT. Will surface open rate after 24h and conversion numbers in the dashboard. :rocket:
